# Geodrome

> Interactive 3D Geodesics & Diametric Antipodes Engine

Geodrome is a modernized, open-source 3D WebGL spherical visualizer and 2D Mercator map projection engine designed to explore Great Circle navigation, orthodromic paths, and diametric antipodal geometry.

- Domain: https://geodrome.pages.dev
- Repository: https://github.com/ny-collins/geodrome
- Concept Credit: Inspired by Ralph Crewe (https://www.ralphcrewe.com/curiosity)

## Core Capabilities

- Interactive 3D WebGL Globe: Orbit controls, camera interpolation, double-tap raycasting coordinate lookup.
- Dual Projection Sync: Synchronized 3D WebGL sphere and 2D Mercator canvas with seam-clipping date line math.
- Geodesic Pathfinding: 3-second animated geodesic tube growth along 8 compass bearings.
- Antipodal Mathematics: Diametric opposite point computation with internal core diameter tunnel lines.
- Dual-Pass X-Ray Transparency: Two-pass THREE.BackSide hollow sphere rendering.

## Mathematical Formulas

- 3D Spherical UV Coordinates: X = r * sin(phi) * cos(theta), Y = r * cos(phi), Z = -r * sin(phi) * sin(theta) where phi = (90 - lat) * rad and theta = lng * rad.
- 2D Mercator Projection: lngToX(lng) = (((lng + 180) % 360 + 360) % 360) / 360 * width.
